results.evidence: 7 tests: persistence, recurrence, FTS, stale edits, import atomicity/idempotence, archive tampering/passwords and CSV protection.
8 integration tests: parent scope on both sides, checksums, reopen, duplicate retry, concurrent note edits, delete-versus-index conflicts, immutable file identity and 10 MiB files.
Two real localhost Noise tests run in both desktop/mobile targets: 14 MiB framed round trip and wrong pinned-key rejection. Synthetic keys only; no real device pairing.
10 Python tests with provider calls mocked: consent, ownership, encrypted/redacted tokens, replay/rate limits, ambiguous sends, revocation and token-rotation race.

Current appearance revision 96c7403 passed TypeScript/Vite, 35 UI logic/analytics/image/theme assertions, workspace Rust tests and native compilation on both macOS and Windows in CI. Local Mac build and 69 Rust executions (67 distinct tests) also pass.

96c7403 development DMG checksum verified, mounted read-only and packaged version 0.5.0 ARM64/Applications shortcut checked. Strict deep ad-hoc signature passes. Delivery copy hash matches packaged DMG; no real-profile launch.
Found an incomplete resource seal. Added explicit ad-hoc signing and verification to the debug-DMG packaging script; rebuilt DMG passes strict deep verification.

App launch exposed missing updater plugin configuration. Added empty pubkey/endpoints configuration; public keys remain supplied by the reviewed update flow. Regression test passes and isolated native app now launches. Normal Mac app and DMG rebuilt.
Gatekeeper assessment rejects the development app. Ad-hoc signing is not Developer ID signing/notarization.

Separate com.personal.commandcenter.qa profile: launch, pinned Markdown note create/edit/search, original attachment import and safe preview, monthly Jan 31 → Feb 28 recurrence, quit/relaunch persistence, readable and encrypted archive export/duplicate-safe restore, wrong-password rejection. ZIP checksums and original attachment bytes independently match. This is a smoke test, not all-feature acceptance.

96c7403 release packaging and workspace tests succeeded in CI. Windows runner: silent install exit 0; native Personal Command Center window stayed running 15 seconds; silent uninstall exit 0. Local installer SHA-256 matches CI evidence. Theme UI received selected native Mac checks; full Windows feature UI and interactive backup prompts remain unverified.

Live accounts, microphones, cloud AI calls, real APNs/FCM delivery, cross-device LAN pairing, real OS reminder delivery and signed updates were not exercised. No models downloaded and no real sends/account connections.

Three integration tests: acknowledgement persists across reopen, next recurrence remains eligible, stale edits rejected, daily/hourly/once/muted policies, snooze timing and invalid targets. Frontend and native compilation pass; new UI controls not yet runtime-tested.

Two catalogue parser tests cover trusted model paths, deduplication, plain metadata and provider-layout failure; two briefing tests cover selected-record inclusion/exclusion, bounds and invalid dates. Frontend compiles. No model downloaded; new UI/live-provider acceptance not claimed.

Six new repository tests: collection/query persistence and cache bounds, numeric watch thresholds with disabled/duplicate handling, explicit owner links and rejected invalid/cyclic ownership. Frontend and native builds pass. New UI workflows not yet native-tested.

10 recurrence/parser tests cover daily/weekly/monthly/yearly, month-end skipping, leap years, ordinal weekdays, interval weeks, IANA DST, DTEND duration, EXDATE/RDATE, inclusive UNTIL and unsupported-rule preservation. Up to 366 occurrences within a 36,600-day scan. RECURRENCE-ID overrides, BYSETPOS, DURATION/EXRULE and unbounded rules remain unexpanded. No live feed/native UI acceptance.

OS schedule registration/removal code for macOS LaunchAgents and Windows Task Scheduler; scheduler string serialization and cross-connection lease tests. QA --reminder-check process passed disabled and enabled checks with desktop notifications off. No OS task registered; real scheduled delivery and Windows runtime remain unverified.

results.area: Floating online assistant and poker search planning
results.evidence: Native QA: panel opening, pointer drag, keyboard movement/reopening, saved position after restart and worldwide/provider search generation. Two Rust query tests and ten UI-logic assertions cover date overlap/end semantics, cancelled events and position bounds. No credential entered, online AI call or browser search sent. Local-AI source preserved dormant.

PCCSTR01 file larger than 64 MiB exported/restored. Full workspace tests cover framing/manifest, wrong passwords, corruption/truncation/trailing bytes, checksum binding, duplicate IDs, cancellation, future versions, attachments/links, vault encryption and excluded permissions. Linked-copy tests preserve originals/configuration, remap relationships/history/attachment versions, check UTF-8 title bounds and roll back changed second-pass input.

Four scope/MIME tests cover metadata versus body authorization, plain preference, attachment subtree exclusion, inert HTML and UTF-8 truncation. Frontend/native compilation pass; no real account or message accessed.

Mac unlocked. Separate QA profile: native .paccs export verified 3 records, wrong password rejected, preview showed 3 existing IDs and 4 history events, missing-only import kept all originals, linked-copy import created 3 copies. Dashboard showed original and copy note/task with unchanged due date. No real profile, private vault or account used.

Two tests cover legacy schedules defaulting to standard format and verified encrypted .paccs writing/restorability, wrong-password rejection and cleanup on failed export. Local/mounted folders supported; direct WebDAV stays standard. Native OS-keychain-backed unattended schedule execution remains unverified; the new format selector was observed in native QA.

Two automated tests cover required consent/scopes, memory expiry, reset and replacement. Native isolated Mac QA: no account configured; scopes/body/background/approval default off; 15-minute interval; stop-and-clear confirmed. No live account read or OAuth acceptance.

13 analytics assertions pass. Native isolated Mac QA matched 4 cached fixtures, recent/provider/positive counts and score 10; saved an Idea Lab research draft and Content Studio draft. Prepared arXiv query with approval still off. No live provider API request or publishing.

Latest iOS Simulator app and Android ARM64 debug APK compile. Selected files ≤10 MiB attach to encrypted record drafts; text/image previews remain in memory and are bounded. No plaintext temp files or automatic uploads. Real file-provider/lifecycle/device workflows are unverified.
